info.title: Notyfi API
info.description: Track anything in a sentence and get notified the moment it happens -- by email, REST API, or MCP. Authenticate every request with a Notyfi API key (`Authorization: Bearer notyfi_mk_...`). Manage keys in your dashboard.

get.summary: List the caller's tenant's API keys
get.description:
Every API key owned by the caller's tenant (live + revoked), WITHOUT key material -- only the
branded display ``prefix`` (null for keys minted before prefixes were stored) + metadata. The
plaintext is shown exactly once, at mint time, and is unrecoverable afterwards.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (per-principal fixed window). Honour the Retry-After + X-RateLimit-* headers.

403.description: The caller authenticated WITH an API key -- api keys cannot manage api keys (use a signed-in user credential).

post.summary: Mint a new API key (the plaintext is returned ONCE, here)

Mint a key owned by the caller's tenant. ``key`` (the plaintext) appears in THIS response ONLY --
Atlas stores just its sha256 hash, so it can never be retrieved again; save it immediately.

post.description:
The HMAC ``signing_secret`` is returned exactly once. Empty ``tracker_ids`` means all of the
account's trackers; otherwise every listed opaque tracker ID must be owned by the account.

Verify ``Notyfi-Signature: v1=<hex>`` as HMAC-SHA256 over
``<Notyfi-Timestamp>.<raw request body>``. Use ``Notyfi-Event-Id`` for event identity and
``Notyfi-Delivery-Id`` to make retries idempotent. Notyfi treats any 2xx as delivered and retries
failures with bounded exponential backoff.

BillingCheckoutCreate.title: BillingCheckoutCreate
BillingCheckoutCreate.description:
Start hosted Checkout for the one public paid plan.

The client chooses a logical plan, never a Stripe Price ID or redirect URL; both are server-owned.

max_active_trackers.title: Max Active Trackers
max_active_trackers.description: Tracker cap for this plan; null means contract-defined/unlimited Enterprise.

max_tracker_creations_24h.title: Max Tracker Creations 24H
max_tracker_creations_24h.description: Rolling 24-hour creation cap; null means contract-defined/unlimited Enterprise.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human label for the key (1-64 chars).

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Capabilities granted to the key. Defaults to read + tracker writes. Use ['read'] for a read-only key.

CreateApiKey.title: CreateApiKey
CreateApiKey.description:
The mint body: a human label for the new key, shown back in listings so a tenant can tell its
keys apart ('CI key', 'Claude Desktop', ...).

identity_pattern.title: Identity Pattern
identity_pattern.description: The registry pattern the sequential dedup lane runs (must match the registry).

adjudication_prompt_skeleton.title: Adjudication Prompt Skeleton
adjudication_prompt_skeleton.description: The same-X judge prompt skeleton (e.g. same-TRANSACTION iff same BBL +/-30d +/-5%).

DedupPolicy.title: DedupPolicy
DedupPolicy.description:
The feed's dedup identity model, declared: the keyer pattern, the same-X adjudication prompt
skeleton (agents fill parameters, never invent identity theory), and the EXPLICIT cost-asymmetry
declaration the prompts encode.

version.title: Version
version.description: Registry name of the pinned engine ('legacy', 'opus-tuned', ...) -- validated against crawler.engines.ENGINES.

config_version.title: Config Version
config_version.description: The engine's config_version at pin time (provenance: which tuning of the recipe produced this feed's current state).

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Per-feed engine overrides, validated against the PINNED engine's declared lever set (search engines: model, web_search_tool, max_uses, max_tokens, max_turns, backfill_days, prompt_addendum; watch-observe declares its own observe-shaped set). null = the engine's registry defaults.

EnginePin.title: EnginePin
EnginePin.description:
Which acquisition-engine recipe runs this feed's search stage, pinned per feed.

The pin is what makes engine rollouts safe: a spec without one (everything compiled
before the registry) resolves to the FROZEN legacy recipe, so shipping a new image never
moves an existing feed. ``overrides`` is the per-feed manual-augmentation surface --
keys AND value coercibility are validated against the PINNED ENGINE's declared lever set
(``Engine.override_keys``; config shapes differ per engine) so a typo'd augmentation
fails at attach-spec, never silently at run time.

EntityRole.title: EntityRole
EntityRole.description: Semantic entity typing for role='entity' fields (acquirer/target, buyer/seller, ...).

Error.title: Error
Error.description: The single error response shape for every 4xx/5xx on the contract.

identity_fields.title: Identity Fields
identity_fields.description: Preferred semantic dedup key (field names, order significant). Fields may be optional when source records are incomplete; the runtime falls back to the stable source envelope (source_key + external_id) whenever any identity value is absent. An empty list explicitly selects source-envelope identity for feeds with no credible semantic key, preserving events without guessing/over-merging.

group_field.title: Group Field
group_field.description: The coarser story/thread key (declared + stored; UI later).

write_mode.description: upsert (default): same identity re-observed = a versioned update; append: every record is a new row (the legacy behavior).

lifecycle.description: End-state declaration; null = the feed has no terminal states.

title_templates.title: Title Templates
title_templates.description: Ordered null-tolerant fallbacks; first template whose {field} references are all non-null wins; list fields render 'lead +N others'.

EventSchema.title: EventSchema
EventSchema.description:
The per-feed extraction OUTPUT CONTRACT (design v1 §3): the declared fields, the identity
key, the timestamp roles, the write mode, and the ordered null-tolerant title templates. A
minimal schema is fields + identity_fields + timestamps.occurred_at + title_templates.

max_items_per_source_backfill.title: Max Items Per Source Backfill
max_items_per_source_backfill.description: Backfill: max records fetched per included source (clamped to <=1000).

max_items_per_tick.title: Max Items Per Tick
max_items_per_tick.description: Tick: max records fetched per included source (clamped to <=100).

max_llm_calls_backfill.title: Max Llm Calls Backfill
max_llm_calls_backfill.description: Backfill: max LLM calls per run, extract + dedup combined (clamped to <=100).

max_llm_calls_tick.title: Max Llm Calls Tick
max_llm_calls_tick.description: Tick: max LLM calls per run, extract + dedup combined (clamped to <=50).

FeedBudget.title: FeedBudget
FeedBudget.description:
The per-feed-run HARD CAPS the runtime enforces (create-a-feed v0 rule: a quote without a
breaker is a liability). ``cost_band`` remains the human-readable prose quote; THIS is the
machine-readable cap derived from it. Hitting any cap stops the run CLEANLY between stages
(budget_hit + a human note on the feed_runs ledger row, exit 0, resumable) -- never a runaway
bill. All fields carry sane defaults so an omitted budget still caps, and every field is CLAMPED
into [1, its _BUDGET_CEILINGS ceiling] -- no spec can grant itself an unbounded budget.

FeedDeliveryUpdate.title: FeedDeliveryUpdate
FeedDeliveryUpdate.description: Owner-scoped notification preference patch for one tracker.

FeedEvent.title: FeedEvent
FeedEvent.description:
The current OPEN head of one deduplicated feed event.

``id`` is the stable canonical event id. ``revision`` hashes the exact event-and-evidence
snapshot used by feed notifications, so dashboard, email, REST, and later MCP consumers can
identify the same immutable revision without treating individual observations as separate cards.

example.summary: A voluntary recall was announced for one affected lot.
example.title: Manufacturer recalls one lot of Example Tablets

FeedEventSource.title: FeedEventSource
FeedEventSource.description: One observation supporting a canonical consumer-feed event revision.

current_value.title: Current Value
current_value.description: The most recent reading the observe fetch saw (single-value kinds; canonical string form).

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When that reading was taken (ISO-8601 UTC).

checked_at.title: Checked At
checked_at.description: When the feed last checked its source, successful or not (ISO-8601 UTC).

FeedMonitorState.title: FeedMonitorState
FeedMonitorState.description:
The LIVE MONITOR READ for an observe feed (feed_monitor_state, 2026-07-19): the
current value the last check saw + when it was seen + when the feed last checked at
all. Deliberately OUTSIDE the event/revision pipeline (a quiet check advances
checked_at without revising anything), so the monitor card can show 'Current Value'
and 'Last checked' truthfully. Detail reads only; null for non-observe feeds and
feeds that have not ticked since the state table shipped.

identity_pattern.title: Identity Pattern
identity_pattern.description: The seeded identity-pattern registry key ('org-event' | 'place-asset' | 'schema-event' | 'search-event') -- validated against crawler.identity_patterns (constrained library, decision #5).

event_types.title: Event Types
event_types.description: Typed event kinds the feed emits ('transaction', 'permit').

FeedOntology.title: FeedOntology
FeedOntology.description: The feed's entity/event vocabulary + the identity pattern that keys its entities.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC stamp when the line was appended.

FeedProgressEntry.title: FeedProgressEntry
FeedProgressEntry.description:
One legible line in a feed request's LIVE research trail (append-only): a UTC timestamp + the
human-readable line ('probed <url> -> socrata 5 rows OK', 'excluded <url>: robots', 'dry-run:
extracted N in-scope', 'spec_ready: slug=... -> attached').

public_id.title: Public Id
public_id.description: Stable opaque tracker identity for dashboard state and canonical tracker routes.

spec.description: The compiled, validated FeedSpec (null until spec_ready).

coverage_report.title: Coverage Report
coverage_report.description: The research Coverage Report (markdown; spec_ready / refused).

owner_email.title: Owner Email
owner_email.description: Feed owner's account email. Populated on operator/admin reads only; always null on tenant-scoped reads.

owner_name.title: Owner Name
owner_name.description: Feed owner's display name (profile display_name, tenants.name fallback). Operator/admin reads only; always null on tenant-scoped reads.

owner_plan.title: Owner Plan
owner_plan.description: Feed owner's effective billing plan (free | pro | enterprise) — pro/enterprise are paying. Operator/admin reads only; always null on tenant-scoped reads.

owner_active_count.title: Owner Active Count
owner_active_count.description: How many active trackers the owner's tenant has (their active-prompt count). Operator/admin reads only; always null on tenant-scoped reads.

monitor.description: Live monitor state for OBSERVE feeds (current value + last check). Populated on tracker DETAIL reads only; null for search feeds, list reads, and feeds that have not checked yet.

FeedRequest.title: FeedRequest
FeedRequest.description:
A tenant-owned feed request (the read shape). ``spec`` is the compiled
:class:`~crawler.feedspec.FeedSpec` -- null until the concierge attaches it (state
``spec_ready``); ``coverage_report`` rides spec_ready AND refused (refusal is a first-class
outcome: the user gets the report, never a junk feed); ``ratified_at`` is stamped once, at
ratification.

example.query: Track everything happening to luxury co-op buildings on the Upper East Side

query.title: Query
query.description: The natural-language feed request ('Track everything happening to UES luxury co-ops').

scope_answers.description: The 3-answer scoping form (event definition / geography / freshness).

cadence.description: Notification cadence. When omitted, legacy scope_answers.freshness is still honored; otherwise daily is the default.

email_enabled.title: Email Enabled
email_enabled.description: Whether this tracker should deliver to the account's verified email.

FeedRequestCreate.title: FeedRequestCreate
FeedRequestCreate.description:
The intake body: the NL query (8..500 chars) + the scoping answers. Submitting creates a
request in state ``submitted``; everything after that is the concierge loop + the ratify gate.

example.query: Track everything happening to luxury co-op buildings on the Upper East Side

scope_answers.event_definition: Recorded transactions, permits, violations, and press on tracked buildings

latest_run.description: The most recent feed_runs ledger row (building/live feeds only).

tick_cadence_seconds.title: Tick Cadence Seconds
tick_cadence_seconds.description: The live feed's tick cadence in seconds: clamp(min(include-source cadence_seconds), 900, 86400), default 1800. Null unless state='live'.

next_tick_at.title: Next Tick At
next_tick_at.description: Approximate next refresh ('expected by'): the latest run's finished_at plus the tick cadence, ISO-8601 UTC. Null unless live with at least one run.

stalled.title: Stalled
stalled.description: True iff the request looks STUCK: state is researching/building AND its last RUN activity (max of updated_at and the latest RUN trail entry's ts -- the human 'retry requested' annotation does not count as run activity) is older than the resume threshold (ATLAS_FEED_RESUME_AFTER_SECONDS, default 45 min) -- the SAME staleness clock the retry route enforces, so a Retry button may be shown if and only if POST /feeds/requests/{id}/retry would be accepted. A retry therefore leaves stalled TRUE until the re-queued run itself resumes and writes activity.

served_total.title: Served Total
served_total.description: TRUE cumulative count of this feed's SERVED (in-scope) signals in the feeds DB -- the number /feeds/{slug}/signals pages over. Null unless state='live' (or on any feeds-DB hiccup; freshness is supplementary and never 500s).

newest_ingested_at.title: Newest Ingested At
newest_ingested_at.description: ingested_at of the NEWEST served signal (when data last actually arrived -- distinct from the last tick, which may have found nothing new). Null unless live with at least one served row.

armed.title: Armed
armed.description: True iff this feed is ARMED -- live and watching with no matching events yet (state='live' AND served_total == 0). A feed reaches live-empty only via the proof-gated arming paths (the research dry-run sentinel, or a clean 0-event backfill whose extractor provably ran), so this cleanly identifies the armed set. Lets the UI render an honest 'armed, no matching events yet' state instead of an error. False for any non-live state, for a feed with served signals, and when served_total could not be computed (never claim 'watching' on missing evidence).

FeedRequestProgress.title: FeedRequestProgress
FeedRequestProgress.description:
LIVE progress for a feed request so ``researching``/``building`` are not dead air: the research
probe-``trail`` (append-only, persisted as the agent probes/proposes/dry-runs) plus, once the build
starts, the ``latest_run`` ledger stats. Tenant-scoped like the request itself (a foreign/absent id
404s).

FeedRequestState.title: FeedRequestState
FeedRequestState.description:
Where a feed request is in its lifecycle. USER-visible: submitted -> researching ->
spec_ready -> {ratified, declined} -> building -> live; ``refused`` is the honest-refusal
outcome (research found no adequate source backbone -- the Coverage Report says why);
``archived`` is the SOFT DELETE ("REMOVE FROM WORKSPACE") that stops serving/polling but KEEPS all
the feed's work and RESERVES its slug. Any visible state can be archived; archived is terminal.
``quarantined`` is the CONTENT-POLICY hold: a create whose query trips moderation is recorded here
instead of researched/served (``refusal_reason`` carries the policy message); reversible to
archived (purge) or submitted (release a false positive).

FeedRunStats.title: FeedRunStats
FeedRunStats.description:
The latest ``feed_runs`` ledger row for a building/live feed (the build ticker the frontend
renders): the fetch/extract/dedup counts + the run status. Read from the ISOLATED feeds DB, keyed
by ``request_id``. All counts default 0 (a run that fetched nothing still has a row).

event_definition.title: Event Definition
event_definition.description: The ratified one-paragraph definition of what counts as an event.

acceptance_examples.title: Acceptance Examples
acceptance_examples.description: In/out scope examples (~20 at ratification) -- the boundary, made testable.

geography.title: Geography
geography.description: Geographic/filter bound (ZIPs, borough/block ranges, ...); null = unbounded.

freshness_expectation.title: Freshness Expectation
freshness_expectation.description: The user's freshness expectation in plain words ('daily', 'within a week').

FeedScope.title: FeedScope
FeedScope.description: The ratified scope: what an EVENT is, the in/out examples, and the geographic/freshness bounds.

event_definition.title: Event Definition
event_definition.description: What counts as an event, in plain words.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description: How fresh the feed must be ('daily', 'within a week').

FeedScopeAnswers.title: FeedScopeAnswers
FeedScopeAnswers.description:
The short intake scoping form riding a feed request: what's an EVENT, the geography/filter
bound, and the freshness expectation -- each in the user's plain words (the concierge compiles
them into the FeedSpec's ratified scope). Unknown keys are rejected (forbid) so a typo'd answer
can never silently vanish from the research brief.

example.event_definition: A recorded transaction, permit, or violation on a tracked building

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Kebab-case feed identifier ('ues-luxury-coops') -- lowercase alphanumerics + hyphens.

version.title: Version
version.description: Spec version (bumped on every ratified change).

query.title: Query
query.description: The original NL query this spec compiles.

scope.description: The ratified scope (event definition + acceptance examples).

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The researched source catalog rows (include + the honest exclusions).

event_schema.description: The per-feed extraction output contract (fields + identity + timestamps + title templates). null = the legacy pattern-shaped extraction path.

cost_band.title: Cost Band
cost_band.description: The quoted cost band ('~$100-300 backfill; low tens $/mo').

budget.description: The machine-readable per-run hard caps the runtime enforces (items fetched + LLM calls). null = the FeedBudget defaults -- a run is ALWAYS capped.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short DISPLAY name for the feed (2-6 words, Title Case, no imperative -- 'Upper East Side Luxury Co-ops', 'Train Crashes Around the World'). Authored by research from the query; the UI shows it on cards/headings with the raw query as subtext. null (legacy specs) -> the UI derives a fallback from the query.

engine.description: Per-feed acquisition-engine pin (version + config_version + declared overrides). null = the frozen legacy recipe, so specs compiled before the engine registry stay byte-for-byte static across image rolls; newly compiled search monitors are stamped explicitly (crawler.engines.default_feed_engine).

sentinel.title: Sentinel
sentinel.description: ARMED WATCHDOG (sentinel feeds): True = this feed is allowed to go LIVE EMPTY. Set by create-a-feed research ONLY when the dry-run proved the pipeline end-to-end (real rows reached the extractor and were classified out-of-scope / unable) but found 0 in-scope events -- expected for a feed over rare events. feed_runner flips such a feed building->live with 0 banked events; a non-sentinel feed still requires >=1 banked event to go live. Never set by the model; defaults False so every existing spec is unaffected.

FeedSpec.title: FeedSpec
FeedSpec.description:
The canonical, versioned create-a-feed artifact: everything the generic engine needs to run
one feed, and everything the partner ratifies. A feed IS its spec.

dedup_policy.adjudication_prompt_skeleton: Same TRANSACTION iff same BBL, dates within 30d, amounts within 5%; cross-type records LINK, never merge.

example.query: Track everything happening to luxury co-op buildings on the Upper East Side

acceptance_examples.text: ACRIS deed recorded for 740 Park Ave

scope.event_definition: A recorded transaction, permit, or violation on a tracked UES luxury co-op building.

FieldRole.title: FieldRole
FieldRole.description: ADVISORY semantic role (non-unique): rendering/UX hints, never branched on by the engine.

FieldType.title: FieldType
FieldType.description: The closed value-type vocabulary of a schema field.

status_field.title: Status Field
status_field.description: The status field name (must exist in fields).

terminal_states.title: Terminal States
terminal_states.description: Status values that mean the event is finished.

LifecycleBlock.title: LifecycleBlock
LifecycleBlock.description: End-state declaration: when status_field lands in terminal_states the event is finished.

NotyfiAccountInfo.title: NotyfiAccountInfo
NotyfiAccountInfo.description:
The consumer identity bound to the access-token subject.

``email`` is populated only from a separately verified, same-sub Cognito ID token.  It is never
accepted from an ordinary request body or copied back from Stripe.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null at end.

total.title: Total
total.description: Count of items in this response (approximate).

required.title: Required
required.description: True = every in-scope record must carry it; a null required field is 'unable'. Fields selected in identity_fields are preferred semantic identity hints and are canonicalized to optional because the engine has a source-envelope fallback.

enum_open.title: Enum Open
enum_open.description: True = enum_values are suggested, not exhaustive.

display_of.title: Display Of
display_of.description: This field is the as-reported display twin of a canonical field.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: THE ranking/filter quantifier (max one per schema).

derived.title: Derived
derived.description: LLM-synthesized from prose, not source-mapped (honesty flag).

description.title: Description
description.description: What to extract -- doubles as the extractor prompt line.

SchemaField.title: SchemaField
SchemaField.description:
One declared output field. ``description`` is REQUIRED -- it doubles as the extraction
prompt line, so it must say what to extract AND any source normalization ('epoch-ms -> ISO').

SourceFormat.title: SourceFormat
SourceFormat.description:
How a source is fetched/parsed. rss/api/socrata/csv/search/observe are MACHINE-READABLE
(v0-includable catalog rows, zero codegen; an observe source is a FROZEN compile-time
target in config['observe'], fetched by the pinned watch-observe engine); html is not
(v1 scraper codegen).

SourceStatus.title: SourceStatus
SourceStatus.description:
A researched source's disposition on the Coverage Report. ``include`` = a live v0 catalog
row; the rest are the HONEST exclusions (refusal-grade transparency, not silence).

SourceTier.title: SourceTier
SourceTier.description: Source truth tier (T1 = authoritative/primary ... T4 = weakest corroboration).

cadence_seconds.title: Cadence Seconds
cadence_seconds.description: Poll cadence in seconds (null until scheduled).

status.description: v0 disposition: include, or the honest exclusion reason class.

config.title: Config
config.description: Per-source adapter knobs -- the runtime compile-target slot (SoQL $where geography scoping, order, id_field/date_field/title_field/url_field, list_path, limit, min_interval_s; plus 'auth' = {key_ref, param|header} = a REFERENCE to a registered research key resolved from the atlas/research-keys vault + injected at fetch time -- the raw key is NEVER stored in the spec). Passed verbatim to the format adapter (crawler.feed_fetch); null = defaults.

SpecSource.title: SpecSource
SpecSource.description:
One researched source as a catalog row: where it is, how it reads, its truth tier, and its
v0 disposition. Every non-include row carries WHY (the Coverage Report's honesty).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The revision-time field (evolving events); null = none.

order_by.title: Order By
order_by.description: The feed-ordering field; null = occurred_at (the default).

TimestampsBlock.title: TimestampsBlock
TimestampsBlock.description: The feed's timestamp roles. All three name datetime-typed fields in ``fields``.

UncertaintyBias.title: UncertaintyBias
UncertaintyBias.description:
The DECLARED dedup cost asymmetry the adjudication prompts encode (documentation that is
load-bearing in prompt TEXT, never branched on -- mirrors IdentityPattern.uncertainty_bias).

WebhookEndpointCreate.description: Register an account webhook; an empty tracker list subscribes to every owned tracker.

tracker_ids.title: Tracker Ids
tracker_ids.description: Empty means every tracker owned by the account.

signing_secret.title: Signing Secret
signing_secret.description: HMAC signing secret, returned exactly once. Store it securely.

tracker_ids.title: Tracker Ids
tracker_ids.description: Empty means every tracker owned by the account.

WebhookEndpointUpdate.title: WebhookEndpointUpdate
WebhookEndpointUpdate.description: Partial endpoint update. An explicit empty tracker list restores account-wide delivery.

WebhookEventType.title: WebhookEventType
WebhookEventType.description: Canonical tracker-event changes available to outgoing Notyfi webhooks.

signing_secret.title: Signing Secret
signing_secret.description: Replacement HMAC signing secret, returned exactly once.
